## Summary

The merged candidate's refused-native-move unit test lost its browser `window` fixture and failed before it could exercise the native refusal. DragDrop's spec now reinstalls its browser globals and real imported singleton references before each test, and restores borrowed state at the file boundary. The physical-drag group runs in order so a preceding-delete control reaches the next real drag; retries remain independent.

Resolves #19590

Evidence: test-only fixture repair and deterministic mutation control; no product runtime change. The original CI interleaving is not claimed reproduced.
Change class: zero-delta (`test`).
Prescription checked: `test/playwright/unit/main/addon/DragDrop.spec.mjs` owns the Node browser fixtures; production drag code remains unchanged.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| 1 — fixture ownership and restoration | File-level `beforeEach` reinstalls the existing EventTarget globals and real singleton references; existing borrowed-state restoration now runs in file-level `afterAll`. |
| 2 — preceding-delete regression | The new deletion control precedes the existing real native-drag test. Removing only the window reinstall reproduces `ReferenceError` at `DragDrop.mjs:441`; restoring it passes. |
| 3 — existing witnesses and neighbors | Refused-move observer body is unchanged; no-document-reset remains. Focused DragDrop/DomEvents/Touch validation passes. |
| 4 — test-only scope | One spec changes; no runtime code, skips, timeout increases, retry count or weakened assertions. Ordered default mode retains independent retries. |

## Deltas from ticket

The focused neighboring run also exposed premature restoration of the file's shared singleton references. Their ownership now follows the same file boundary as the browser fixtures.

## Test Evidence

Mutation: remove only `globalThis.window = windowRef` from the new hook, then run the physical-window group with retries disabled. The preceding-delete control succeeds and the following real drag fails at the production window-coordinate read. Restore the hook, then run DragDrop, DomEvents and Touch together. This distinguishes the fixture repair from a lucky isolated retry.
